```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r}
library(geomask)
data(geomask_pts)
data(geomask_boundary)
data(geomask_pop)
```

## Desplazamiento según densidad

```{r density}
masked_den <- mask_density_displacement(
  geomask_pts,
  pop_layer = geomask_pop,
  density_col = "density",
  r_base = 1200,
  r_min_base = 250,
  scale_fun = "logistic",
  seed = 10
)
summary(masked_den$geomask_density_scale)
```

## Restricción por límite administrativo

```{r context, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
masked_ctx <- mask_context_aware(
  geomask_pts,
  method = mask_donut,
  boundary = geomask_boundary,
  min_r = 300,
  max_r = 900,
  seed = 11
)
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  print(plot_mask_comparison(geomask_pts, masked_ctx, boundary = geomask_boundary,
                             title = "Context-aware donut"))
}
```

## Agregación adaptativa por comuna

```{r agg}
masked_agg <- mask_adaptive_aggregation(
  geomask_pts,
  zones = geomask_boundary,
  zone_id = "zone_id",
  k = 8,
  merge_method = "centroid_dist"
)
nrow(masked_agg)
```
